query: My Mac says the startup disk is almost full but I can't find what's using it.
setup: A macOS host where APFS local Time Machine snapshots and Xcode DerivedData dominate; df 'free' is misleading because of purgeable space.
expected_behavior: Dispatches to the macOS module (references/darwin.md + scripts/os/darwin.sh), NOT the Linux/systemd path
Explains that APFS 'free' includes purgeable space so df understates the problem
Surfaces APFS local snapshots via tmutil as the likely biggest reclaimable chunk
Recommends tmutil thinlocalsnapshots (user action) rather than hand-deleting snapshot files
Identifies Xcode DerivedData / CoreSimulator and brew cleanup as regenerable wins
Treats Nix store levers as OS-agnostic (launchd, not systemd, for scheduled GC)
Proposes a ranked plan and waits for approval before any deletion
